debug_name: Chapel interior + descent staircase to Limbo
_comment: Vertical-stack region 2 of 3: the chapel building's interior floor + the entire descent staircase down to Limbo. Owns chapel_interior.glb (interior floor + upper-flight steps + continuous descent + corridor walls/ceiling). No terrain (chapel floor + descent corridor are static mesh). Triggers fire on both seams: north back to surface (exiting the chapel door), south down to limbo (stepping off the last descent step).

triggers._comment: Player walks back out the chapel door. Same trigger volume as surface's chapel_door_enter (mirrored across door threshold). Instant + preserve_player_pos -- continuous world, no teleport.

Player steps off the last continuous-descent step onto Limbo's floor. Trigger sits at the bottom-of-stairs landing (world Z ~= -346.85, Y ~= -43.13). Corridor cross-section is 4.8m wide (±2.4m X). Instant + preserve_player_pos.

_ai_block_volumes_note: Single thin barrier at the descent-corridor MOUTH (where the stairs meet Limbo's floor at Z=-346.85). Limbo shades can roam the entire Limbo disc (anywhere south of the mouth) but hit an invisible wall the moment they try to cross north into the corridor / climb the stairs. Doctrine: shades can only ever touch Limbo terrain; the corridor itself is the threshold to outside-Hell. Owner = chapel_interior so chapel_interior actors (none today) would ignore the barrier; Limbo shades (foreign region) hit it.

ai_block_volumes._comment: Descent corridor mouth at Limbo's floor. Thin Z-wall just north of the corridor exit step (Z=-346.85). 4m deep covers the seam with margin so a fast shade can't tunnel through in one frame. Y range covers Limbo floor (-43.13) up a couple meters; doesn't need to extend higher since shades only walk along the floor plane.
